name: Payroll, Employee, Insider Fraud and Collusion
description: Employees or contractors abuse access to divert funds, create ghost employees, falsify expenses or collude with outsiders. Weak segregation of duties and unchecked privileged access raise risk.

sources.text: ACFE, Occupational Fraud 2024: A Report to the Nations (2024)
Fraud Advisory Panel (UK), guidance on internal fraud (general)
COSO and ACFE, Fraud Risk Management Guide (2016)

exposure.rationale: Ghost employees, expense and vendor fraud within payroll and procurement flows, committed by staff; also bank staff abusing privileged access.

indicators.name: Ghost employee or duplicate bank account on payroll
indicators.canon: Ghost employee or duplicate bank account on payroll
indicators.desc: Payroll records show employees without HR evidence or shared bank details.
indicators.ctx: Payroll records show employees without HR evidence or shared bank details.
refs: ACFE, Report to the Nations (published biennially)

indicators.name: Expense claims just below approval limits
indicators.canon: Payments or claims split to stay below internal approval limits
indicators.desc: Payments, claims or contracts are broken into amounts just under internal authorisation limits.
indicators.ctx: Pattern of claims under thresholds or with duplicate receipts.
refs: ACFE, Report to the Nations (published biennially)

indicators.name: Employee never takes leave or resists rotation
indicators.canon: Employee never takes leave or resists rotation
refs: ACFE, Report to the Nations (published biennially)

indicators.name: Staff lifestyle inconsistent with pay
refs: ACFE, Report to the Nations (published biennially)

indicators.name: Excessive access or override of controls
indicators.canon: Staff override of controls or excessive record access
indicators.desc: Employees override approvals, alter records, access records without need or show unusual relationships with customers.
indicators.ctx: Privileged users bypass approvals or alter records.
refs: ACFE, Report to the Nations (published biennially)

indicators.name: Employee accounts receive unusual payments
indicators.desc: Staff accounts credited from customers, vendors or dormant accounts.
indicators.ctx: Staff accounts credited from customers, vendors or dormant accounts.
refs: ACFE, Report to the Nations (published biennially)

indicators.name: Vendor with staff-linked address or bank details
indicators.canon: Vendor linked to employee or without verifiable existence
indicators.desc: Vendor has no verifiable address, tax number or deliveries, or shares address or bank details with an employee.
indicators.ctx: Procurement or payment to entity linked to an employee.
refs: ACFE, Report to the Nations (published biennially)

indicators.name: Customer complaints about staff handling
indicators.desc: Repeated complaints or unauthorised changes by one employee.
indicators.ctx: Repeated complaints or unauthorised changes by one employee.
refs: ACFE, Report to the Nations (published biennially)

indicators.name: Alterations to payroll or master data outside cycle
indicators.canon: Alterations to payroll or master data outside cycle
indicators.desc: Changes made around pay run by one user.
indicators.ctx: Changes made around pay run by one user.
refs: ACFE, Report to the Nations (published biennially)
